description: This Go source file implements a client for interacting with the 'docs-i18n' system via RPC, managing process communication, sending prompts, and handling responses for an internationalization documentation tool.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: A client managing an external process for RPC communication, handling prompt requests and response parsing.

classes.name: docsPiClientOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for starting a docsPiClient, including system prompt and thinking delay.

classes.name: piEvent
classes.description: Represents events received from the docs-i18n process, categorized by type.

classes.name: agentEndPayload
classes.description: Structured payload for agent end messages, containing message history.

classes.name: rpcResponse
classes.description: Represents a response from the RPC server, with status, command details, and error information.

classes.name: agentMessage
classes.description: Represents a message from the agent, including role, content, and potential error or stop reason.

classes.name: contentBlock
classes.description: A segment of content within a message, distinguished by type (e.g., 'text').

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the docsPiClient process with specified options.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the process and waits for a response or natural language output.

methods.name: Stderr
methods.description: Returns the captured standard error output from the process.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the client process, signaling shutdown.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Internal helper to capture and buffer stderr output.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Internal helper to read stdout and parse incoming event messages.

methods.name: extractTranslationResult
methods.description: Extracts the translation or response text from a raw agent message.

methods.name: extractContentText
methods.description: Parses the content of a message, handling both string and blocks formats.

methods.name: decodeRpcResponse
methods.description: Decodes a raw JSON message into an rpcResponse structure.

methods.name: getDocsPiAgentDir
methods.description: Determines or creates the directory for the agent, caching the value.
